# Zendesk

Zendesk provides customer support software with ticketing, live chat, and knowledge base features, enabling efficient helpdesk operations and customer engagement

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zendesk/.

## Actions

- **Count Zendesk Organizations** (read-only): Count the number of organizations in zendesk.
- **List Tickets** (read-only): List zendesk tickets with pagination and filtering.
- **Create Zendesk Organization**: Create an organization in zendesk.
- **Create Zendesk Ticket**: Create a ticket in zendesk.
- **Delete Zendesk Organization**: Delete an organization in zendesk.
- **Delete Zendesk Ticket**: Delete a ticket in zendesk.
- **Get Zendesk About Me** (read-only): Get information about the owner account in zendesk.
- **Get Zendesk Organization** (read-only): Get information about a specific organization in zendesk.
- **Get Zendesk Organizations** (read-only): Get all organizations in zendesk.
- **Get Zendesk Ticket** (read-only): Get ticket details from zendesk.
- **Reply to Zendesk Ticket**: Action to reply to a zendesk ticket by adding a comment.
- **Update Zendesk Organization**: Update an organization in zendesk.
